notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). LLM gateway deployment: LiteLLM Proxy via docker run and a Compose stack (Postgres, Redis), model routing/fallback/semantic-cache/Langfuse config, virtual keys and budgets through the LiteLLM admin API, an nginx alternative for vLLM replicas, and health/spend checks.

Medium because it has the agent run a downloaded container with the user's real provider keys passed in (`docker run ... -e OPENAI_API_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-latest`, SKILL.md:34-45) and call the gateway's admin API with `$LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` to generate keys and read spend (173-241). Acceptable: keys are taken from the user's environment and stay on their machine and gateway, all API calls go to the user's own localhost:4000 proxy, and gating provider keys behind per-team virtual keys is the point of the skill.

Users should pin the image instead of the moving `main-latest` tag (SKILL.md:42, 127), drop `--detailed_debug` outside debugging since it can log request content and headers, and replace the hardcoded `postgresql://litellm:password@...` and `POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password` (118, 137, 150). The key/generate example body contains `#` comments, which is not valid JSON and will fail as written (182-185). Related Skills links to `../../local-ai/...` and `../../../devops/ai/...` (263-266) are optional sibling skills that do not ship with this one.
